slides.notes: User item 0 precedes the TabPFN explanation. Network changes are the operational motivation, not a new cross-dataset experiment or an established robustness result. ICD Introduction motivates pretraining and transfer in tabular prediction; its §4 tuned-XGB comparison is historical benchmark evidence, not a universal conclusion about v3. https://arxiv.org/pdf/2402.06971

slides.notes: PFN = Prior-data Fitted Network. Context is labelled task data, not a natural-language prompt. PriorLabs TabPFN-3 report §2; local architecture and classifier implementation. https://arxiv.org/pdf/2605.13986

slides.notes: Illustrative schema, no fabricated performance values. Context rows and held-out query rows remain distinct. Classification output labels are those represented by the fitted context.

slides.notes: Actual saved checkpoint config inspected with torch.load. Parameters counted and hashed in docs/research/20261015/tabpfn_fit_mechanism_check.json. Version 8.2.0 is the installed library, not the model generation. Local checkpoint: tabpfn/tabpfn-v3-classifier-v3_20260417_multiclass.ckpt. Model report Appendix C; support ceilings are not measured IDS performance.

slides.band: 열의 정보를 먼저 통합한 뒤 행 사이의 관계를 추론
slides.notes: Redrawn from local architectures/tabpfn_v3.py TabPFNV3 docstring and forward path, with report Figure 5 as architecture cross-check. Local checkpoint: feature_group_size=3, dist_embed_num_blocks=3, feat_agg_num_blocks=3, feat_agg_num_cls_tokens=4. https://arxiv.org/pdf/2605.13986#page=6

slides.title: v3 구조 · context 관계와 클래스 확률의 계산
slides.band: 새 클래스의 라벨 사례를 context에 넣어 출력 클래스에 반영
slides.notes: Local ICLTransformerBlock uses train-only keys; ManyClassDecoder uses train representations and one-hot labels. Report §§2.1–2.2, Figure 5. The actual checkpoint has max_num_classes=160; this is a checkpoint constraint even though decoder weights are independent of class count. No unlabeled novel-class naming is implied.

slides.title: fit과 predict · context 캐시의 생성과 재사용
slides.band: 가중치가 고정되어도 context 준비와 query 계산 비용 발생
slides.notes: 1014: scripts/v7/exp72/replay_models.py fit_stage calls TabPFNClassifier.fit, using get_model in exp71_bounded_updates.py. fit_with_cache builds context-dependent state and predict reuses it. Actual parameter SHA-256 unchanged after 1000→1020 fit: see mechanism check. The current library does not incrementally append 20 rows to the old cached state in this experiment. Report §2.4.2 distinguishes cache build vs cached predict.

slides.title: 데이터 적응의 세 방식과 학습 대상
slides.band: Context 갱신과 가중치 fine-tuning은 서로 다른 적응 연산
slides.notes: TabPFNClassifier versus FinetunedTabPFNClassifier in installed official 8.2.0 source. ICD optimizes input context features through a frozen model, as Ma et al. 2024. 1014 ordinary PFN used row 1; EXP75 used context-feature optimization; EXP74 trained external classification heads and is not the user-referenced experiment.

slides.title: v3 가중치 fine-tuning · 학습 절차
slides.band: Query 정답의 손실로 θ 갱신 · 미세조정 이후에도 context를 사용
slides.notes: The v3 report describes architecture and variants but is not a detailed task-specific fine-tuning tutorial. Procedure here is grounded in the installed official finetuning/finetuned_base.py and finetuned_classifier.py. Cross entropy over query labels; AdamW; explicit independent validation; final inference classifier fits X_, y_. https://github.com/PriorLabs/TabPFN/blob/main/src/tabpfn/finetuning/finetuned_classifier.py

slides.title: 가중치 fine-tuning의 실제 설정 항목
slides.notes: Illustrative configuration only, not a new quality result. Pin checkpoint with extra_classifier_kwargs[model_path]. Use epochs=10, learning_rate=1e-5, context+query=1024, query ratio=.2, one estimator as an initial engineering smoke configuration, not a tuned best setting. Validation supplied separately; no test tuning. Official repository recommends high-memory GPU for its 50k example, so batch/context size must be validated on this 24GB GPU.

slides.title: 신규 사례만 사용하는 갱신의 의미
slides.band: 이번 a·b·c 비교의 중심은 context에 어떤 사례를 유지하는지
slides.notes: User clarified 1000 and 20 were examples, not required sample counts. Ordinary classifier supports a newly represented class through labels in context. A naive FinetunedTabPFNClassifier.fit on a single new class is not equivalent to old-context-plus-new-class training: its train/context label space and validation differ. New-query-only gradients with old context retained need a separate controlled training loop and old-class retention validation; not silently substituted into this experiment.
